objectives.statement: Identify common noun-forming suffixes and what kind of meaning they add.
Build common nouns for people and actions from familiar verbs.
Recognize frequent prefixes and simple compound nouns in everyday words.
Choose and correct word forms in short Norwegian sentences.

notes: Must teach productive B1-level word formation so learners can recognize and build related word families: common suffixes (-het, -else, -ing/-ning, agent -er) and frequent prefixes. Reference basic compounds from compound_nouns; defer complex compounds and less transparent derivations to advanced_word_formation.
